overnight gaps can exceed initial risk

inputs.events: full-day CPI/FOMC/NFP entry blackout; earnings through holding horizon; no implicit absent-calendar approval

evidence: forward shadow only; synthetic smoke is segregated; no replay/holdout input or performance claim
